item.title: Mountain West Groups Partner to Support Quantum and Photonics Innovation
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Innosphere, on behalf of the National Science Foundation ASCEND Engine, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Montana Photonics and Quantum Alliance (MPQA) and the Headwaters Tech Hub (HTH). The agreement lays the foundation for a larger Mountain West innovation and test facilities network, connecting two federally supported regional […]
